explanation: The team entered the two-man and four-man events in Canada. Their four-man sled crashed during the competition, and the crew walked beside it to the finish line.

claims.text: Jamaica's bobsleigh team made its Olympic debut at the 1988 Winter Olympics in Calgary.
Jamaica did not compete in Olympic bobsleigh at Sarajevo 1984, and Albertville 1992 and Lillehammer 1994 came after its debut.
At Calgary 1988 Jamaica entered both the two-man and the four-man bobsleigh events.
Jamaica's four-man sled crashed at Calgary, and the crew walked alongside it to the finish.
The 1993 film Cool Runnings was loosely based on the Jamaican bobsleigh team.
